name: customer-magic
description: Customer Magic — the workbench your harness is missing. Revenue work that persists between sessions.

plugins.name: customer-magic
plugins.description: Run your pipeline from the agent you already work in. A setup that connects and checks your inbox, calendar, sign-up source and CRM and remembers where it stopped; four commands (/customer-magic:setup, :review, :today, :status); nine playbooks for importing a list, keeping a CRM in step, closing out an event, today's follow-ups, logging a call, the weekly review, handing deals over, a background review of everything that comes in, and going through that review in a conversation; and three background workers that propose and never decide. Includes the Customer Magic connection, so the work persists between sessions.
